thread:
emily-s: Quick heads-up — proposing a temporary runtime pin for llama3q after today's longseq canary flaps. Details below.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] runtime pin applied
- target: runtime
- version: 2.14.3
- models: llama3q-*
- initiated_by: emily-s
- reason: kv-cache OOM during longseq canary
- expires: 2026-03-16T10:00:00Z

maya-w: Can you paste the canary failure snippet? We need to confirm scope (canary only vs broader rollout).

raj-p: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T16:02:12Z ERROR kv_cache: shard=3 allocate failed, OOM, attempted=1.2G
context: seq_len=65536, batch=1
stack: runtime::alloc_cache -> runtime::serve_request
```
Root cause looks like eviction didn't scale for very long sequences.

luca-m: This matches an edge-case in the recent kv-cache resize path. PR #4677 fixes eviction heuristics. It's in review, tests failing on one unit. ETA for green if we rebase = tonight.

emily-s: Suggest policy: keep pin for 18-20 hours (gives time for review + canary retest). If PR merges today, we can do an early unpin and rerun canary.

maya-w: I'll post on #ops-notice and update the 2.14.3 release notes with 'temporary pin due to kv-cache longseq OOM'. Also set a metric alert for kv_cache.size and per-shard OOM count (threshold: >3 in 15m).

raj-p: Unpin plan if PR lands:
- merge PR
- deploy hotfix to canary pool
- run 50 canary requests with seq_len>32k
- if green, request unpin via deployctl and schedule canary watch for 2h

sre-ops-bot: Incident: created INC-2026-0315-llama3q-kvcache, severity=low, owner=maya-w

emily-s: Can we avoid rolling back to older runtime? That may change perf profiles for other models.

luca-m: Agree. Pinning forward to the version that passed QA previously (2.14.3) is safer than rolling back. Rollback to 2.14.2 is only if 2.14.3 proves unstable across customers.

maya-w: I'll add a customer-facing note: brief explanation + expected window. emily-s, want to approve wording?

emily-s: sgtm. Keep communication tight. Post again when PR merges or if we extend the pin.

raj-p: I'll try a hotfix branch and post CI link. If anyone wants to run a repro, use:
```
python repro_longseq.py --model llama3q --seq 65536 --batch 1
```

maya-w: :thumbsup: on the plan. Updating tickets.

deploy-bot: Reminder: manual unpin required. To remove pin:
```
deployctl pin remove --target runtime --version 2.14.3 --models "llama3q-*"
```

emily-s: thanks all. Keep updates in thread so we have a single source.
